title: About Us
subtitle: Learn About Our History and Mission
intro: Christ Is The Answer is a church network with presence in Bolivia and other South American countries, committed to sharing the love of Christ with all nations.

1969.title: Arrival in Bolivia
1969.description: The founders arrived in Santa Cruz de la Sierra, Bolivia, after hearing God's call while serving as missionaries in Chile.

1969b.title: Headquarters Founded
1969b.description: The headquarters was established in Santa Cruz, beginning to preach in the humble neighborhood of El Lazareto.

1972.title: Expansion to Cochabamba
1972.description: The Cochabamba church was founded, marking the beginning of expansion across Bolivia.

1978.title: Legal Recognition
1978.description: The organization received legal recognition through Supreme Resolution No. 188425 from Bolivia's Ministry of Foreign Relations.

2002.title: International Expansion
2002.description: The church was established in Buenos Aires, Argentina, consolidating presence in South America.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: Our spiritual mission is to bring people back to the apostolic faith, preaching the gospel of Jesus Christ and serving our communities with love.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.description: To be a church network that transforms lives through the message of Christ, reaching all nations with the gospel.

faith.title: Faith
faith.description: We believe in the transforming power of faith in Jesus Christ.

love.title: Love
love.description: We love God and our neighbor as ourselves.

service.title: Service
service.description: We serve our community with humility and dedication.

unity.title: Unity
unity.description: We work together as a family of faith.

presence.title: Our Presence
presence.description: We are present in multiple South American countries, serving thousands of families.

cta.title: Be Part of Our Family
cta.description: We invite you to get to know us and be part of our faith community.
